description: Turn the switch on, press the button (green LED off), open the drawer. The same behaviors as button_drawer_switch in another order; the drawer stays closed until the end. Random scenes: the joints the task doesn't fix are random at each reset, the blocks lie somewhere on the table, the conditions are rendered in 4 random scenes. Long runs, see dynaguide_scripts/run_long_runs_1.bat and run_long_runs_2.bat. Make it with dynaguide_scripts/make_task.py
